story_overview: On a misty night at Cliffside Pass, Kazuo stops his truck to check on Ren, a motorcyclist. A tense conversation ensues involving a cracked helmet and a bloody phone, culminating in a crash that leaves Ren standing by a wrecked white car.

video_prompts:
Ren: Figure wearing a dark, matte black, high-collared tactical motorcycle suit and a red full-face motorcycle helmet with a dark visor.
Kazuo: Older man with gray hair, wearing a green jacket over a white shirt and a grey cap/beanie.
Cliffside Pass: A winding road cut into the side of a dark, rocky mountain cliffside.
the Chinese text message: On-screen digital text composed of Chinese language characters.

The Chinese text message is an overlay. On a misty night, on the winding road of Cliffside Pass, Kazuo turns to look at Ren with a concerned expression. The large red truck is parked nearby against the rock wall.
With the Chinese text message on screen, Ren raises a hand to touch the cracked surface of their red helmet.
Kazuo stands in front of the red truck and speaks with a concerned expression. Ren, viewed from behind, tilts her head as she listens.

Animated, eye-level close-up of Ren wearing the red helmet against a dark background with the Chinese text message on screen. Ren's hand, covered by the black motorcycle glove, slowly reaches up to touch the side of their helmet.

the bloody flip phone: Open white flip phone stained with blood.

Kazuo, wearing the green jacket, stands in front of the red truck, speaking into the bloody flip phone he holds to his ear. Facing him, Ren, wearing her red motorcycle helmet and dark brown tactical motorcycle suit, stands with her back to the camera.
